ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: At the bottom of the figure is a common wire; below the left branch is a voltage source labeled 2V, with the upper end of the symbol as “+” and the lower end as “-”, and its upper-end node is labeled a. Above the left branch is a current source labeled 2A, with the arrow upward, connected to the top node; the top left is labeled b, and the top wire connects b to the two vertical branches in the middle and on the right. The middle branch and the right branch each have a 1Ω resistor, and both are connected from the top node to the bottom common wire. Then reason: Take the bottom common wire as the 0V reference point. Since the upper end of the 2V voltage source is positive and node a is at its upper end, V_a = 2V. The current source arrow is upward, indicating that 2A current is injected into the top node b. Let the top node voltage be V_b, then the currents flowing from b to the reference point through the two 1Ω resistors are respectively V_b/1Ω and V_b/1Ω. Write KCL for node b: V_b/1 + V_b/1 = 2, obtaining 2V_b = 2, so V_b = 1V. The voltage U_ab = V_a - V_b = 2V - 1V = 1V.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit from the image: choose the bottom wire as 0 V; node a is the positive terminal of the 2 V source, and node b is the top node feeding two 1 Ω resistor branches. From the voltage source, V_a = 2 V. Apply KCL at node b: the 2 A current source injects 2 A upward into b, and the current leaves through the two 1 Ω resistors, so V_b/1 + V_b/1 = 2. Solve V_b = 1 V, then compute U_ab = V_a - V_b = 2 - 1 = 1 V.

method.method_draft: First describe the image-based circuit: the only passive path from node b to the bottom rail consists of two 1 Ω resistors in parallel, while the left branch has a 2 A current source above a 2 V source. Replace the two 1 Ω resistors by their equivalent R_eq = 1 || 1 = 0.5 Ω from b to the bottom node. The upward 2 A source supplies this equivalent load, so the top-node voltage is V_b = 2 A × 0.5 Ω = 1 V. Independently, the 2 V source fixes V_a = 2 V relative to the bottom node. Therefore U_ab = V_a - V_b = 1 V.
